id: \bUh...\nOh, yes, I'm the Move Deleter.
en: \bUh...\nOh, yes, I'm the Move Deleter.

id: \bI can make Pokémon forget their moves.
en: \bI can make Pokémon forget their moves.

id: \bWould you like me to do that?
en: \bWould you like me to do that?

id: \bWhich Pokémon should forget a move?
en: \bWhich Pokémon should forget a move?
it: \bQuale Pokémon deve dimenticare una mossa?

id: \bCome again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
en: \bCome again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
it: \bTorna pure se ci sono mosse da far dimenticare.

id: \bWhat? No Egg should know any moves.
en: \bWhat? No Egg should know any moves.
it: \bCosa? Un Uovo non dovrebbe conoscere nessuna mossa.

id: \bWhat? I can't make a Shadow Pokémon forget a move.
en: \bWhat? I can't make a Shadow Pokémon forget a move.
it: \bCosa? Non posso far dimenticare una mossa a un Pokémon Ombra.

en: \b\v[3] seems to know only one move...

id: \bWhich move should be forgotten?
en: \bWhich move should be forgotten?
it: \bQuale mossa deve essere dimenticata?

id: \bHm! \v[3]'s \v[4]? That move should be forgotten?
en: \bHm! \v[3]'s \v[4]? That move should be forgotten?

id: \bIt worked to perfection!
en: \bIt worked to perfection!

id: \b\v[3] has forgotten \v[4] completely.
en: \b\v[3] has forgotten \v[4] completely.

en: \bRoark is strong. He uses Rock types!

en: \bWelcome to the Canalave City Library. Fell free to look around.

en: \rByron is strong. He uses Steel types!

en: \rDawn: You made it.

en: It's a book. The title is Zubatman vs. Spinarakman: the Crossover.
it: È un libro. Il titolo è Zubatman contro Spinarakman: il crossover.

id: \bThe kids can't decide who the best Gym Leader is. I prefer Jasmine to be honest.
en: \bThe kids can't decide who the best Gym Leader is. I prefer Jasmine to be honest.
it: \bI ragazzi non riescono a decidere chi sia il Capopalestra migliore. A essere sincero, io preferisco Jasmine.

id: A bunch of books. Best to leave them alone.
en: A bunch of books. Best to leave them alone.
it: Un mucchio di libri. Meglio lasciarli stare.

id: \rWho are you? Have you no respect for privacy. Kids these days...
en: \rWho are you? Have you no respect for privacy.  Kids these days...
it: \rChi sei? Non hai rispetto per la privacy? I ragazzi d'oggi...

id: \bWait, what? Why do you assume I use birds?
en: \bWait, what? Why do you assume I use birds?
it: \bAspetta, cosa? Perché dai per scontato che io usi gli uccelli?

id: \bGoh: The history here is incredible. I'd like to try out some of their technology.
en: \bGoh: The history here is incredible. I'd like to try out some of their technology.
it: \bGoh: La storia di questo posto è incredibile. Mi piacerebbe provare un po' della loro tecnologia.

id: \bCan't find any books you like? Maybe this will satisfy you better.
en: \bCan't find any books you like? Maybe this will satisfy you better.
it: \bNon trovi nessun libro che ti piace? Forse questo ti soddisferà di più.

id: \bKnowledge is power. It's best to be armed and ready.
en: \bKnowledge is power. It's best to be armed and ready.
it: \bIl sapere è potere. Meglio essere armati e pronti.

id: \rCynthia: \PN, I didn't know you were interested in history.
en: \rCynthia: \PN, I didn't know you were interested in history.
it: \rCamilla: \PN, non sapevo che ti interessasse la storia.

id: \rDawn: So long as it involves Pokémon.
en: \rDawn: So long as it involves Pokémon.
it: \rLucinda: Basta che riguardi i Pokémon.

id: \rCynthia: It does. Back in ancient times, when Sinnoh was known as Hisui, Pokémon and humans were just learning how to coexist.
en: \rCynthia: It does. Back in ancient times, when Sinnoh was known as Hisui, Pokémon and humans were just learning how to coexist.
it: \rCamilla: Li riguarda eccome. Nell'antichità, quando Sinnoh era conosciuta come Hisui, Pokémon ed esseri umani stavano appena imparando a convivere.

id: \rRare Pokémon existed as well, such as regional forms for Growlithe and Braviary, and evolutions of Stantler and Basculin.
en: \rRare Pokémon existed as well, such as regional forms for Growlithe and Braviary, and evolutions of Stantler and Basculin.
it: \rEsistevano anche Pokémon rari, come le forme regionali di Growlithe e Braviary e le evoluzioni di Stantler e Basculin.

id: \bGoh: How did people catch them?
en: \bGoh: How did people catch them?
it: \bGoh: Come facevano a catturarli?

id: \rThere are some schematics behind me. Wooden Poké Ball were the primary method.
en: \rThere are some schematics behind me. Wooden Poké Ball were the primary method.
it: \rDietro di me ci sono degli schemi. Le Poké Ball di legno erano il metodo principale.

id: \rThere were also records of some Pokémon being brought to the region. I'm studying them to see how they affected the ecosystem.
en: \rThere were also records of some Pokémon being brought to the region. I'm studying them to see how they affected the ecosystem.
it: \rCi sono anche documenti su alcuni Pokémon portati nella regione. Li sto studiando per capire come abbiano influito sull'ecosistema.

id: \rSpeaking of, would you like one for yourself?
en: \rSpeaking of, would you like one for yourself?
it: \rA proposito, ne vorresti uno tutto per te?

id: There is no room for it.
en: There is no room for it.
it: Non c'è spazio.

id: \rCynthia: Fair choice. It-
en: \rCynthia: Fair choice. It-
it: \rCamilla: Ottima scelta. È-

id: \rDawn: Did you all feel that?
en: \rDawn: Did you all feel that?
it: \rLucinda: L'avete sentito anche voi?

id: \rCynthia: I did. I think it came from Mount Coronet.
en: \rCynthia: I did. I think it came from Mount Coronet.
it: \rCamilla: Sì. Credo che venisse dal Monte Corona.

id: \rMy Pokémon are fidgiting in their Poké Balls from it. Come on. There's no time to waste.
en: \rMy Pokémon are fidgiting in their Poké Balls from it.  Come on. There's no time to waste.
it: \rI miei Pokémon si agitano nelle loro Poké Ball per colpa di questo. Forza. Non c'è tempo da perdere.

id: \rCynthia: We'll break here and leave soon. Be sure to have your Pokémon fully healed before we go.
en: \rCynthia: We'll break here and leave soon. Be sure to have your Pokémon fully healed before we go.
it: \rCamilla: Facciamo una pausa qui e poi ripartiamo. Assicurati che i tuoi Pokémon siano in piena forma prima di andare.
